designs.name: Novice aux cordes
designs.design: Young adult male, lean and long-limbed, rounded pale mottled cranial dome, six thick short tendrils falling to shoulders, four fleshy facial mandibles plainly spread enough to read. High-collared sleeveless charcoal canvas tunic over a long-sleeved brown undershirt, narrow muted crimson sash, wrapped calves and simple claw-open foot bindings. Holds a compact coil of natural rope at one hip, opposite palm open at chest height; relaxed tilted shoulders. One small soft belt pouch, no armor.

designs.name: Novice des tablettes
designs.design: Young adult female Yautja with fully alien head, short compact practical build, broad amber-brown domed skull with sparse crest studs and short thick tendrils bound low behind the skull. Four external mandibles. Modest black split oversmock over loose dark trousers and dull brick-red woven waist belt. Holds a small plain wooden practice tablet to her torso with both hands and a short bone stylus tucked in belt. Feet planted close, head angled inquisitively toward viewer. Thin wrist cloth wraps, no jewelry or armor.

designs.name: Novice du paquetage
designs.design: Young adult male, unusually tall narrow shoulders and long shins, darker olive speckled skull, flattened wide alien brow and irregular short thick tendrils swept toward one shoulder. Readable four mandibles. Charcoal diagonal wrap jacket with elbow-length sleeves, rust-red broad cloth cross belt, charcoal knee-length divided lower wrap. A rolled blanket secured high across small canvas backpack, hands lightly gripping straps. Modest practical silhouette with one knee bent; no elite metal gear.

designs.name: Novice des gobelets
designs.design: Young adult female, sturdy barrel torso and short lower legs, pale sand scales and ridged domed Yautja head; two bands gather thick scalp tendrils into two low alien bundles, not human pigtail hair. Four mandibles. Simple black short-sleeved tunic, red square apron tied over trousers, brown wraps around forearms and shins. Carries two nested small plain ceramic cups at waist and a folded cleaning cloth in other hand. Slight weight shift, no armor, flat modest chest covering.

designs.name: Novice du cuir
designs.design: Young adult male, medium height with narrow waist and rounded heavy Yautja cranium in dark copper mottling, short thick tendrils clipped into a broad fan. Four external mandibles visible. Coarse charcoal vest fully closed over a grey sleeved tunic, narrow red sash hanging on left and brown loose trousers. Holds an unstitched leather pouch and simple bone awl at chest level, safely pointed away; tool roll soft at belt. Elbows tucked, body turned slightly right.

designs.name: Novice des graines
designs.design: Young adult female alien, tall slender silhouette with long arms, cream-grey speckled domed skull, pronounced asymmetric orbital ridges and midlength thick tendrils tied into a low narrow tail. Four mandibular lobes around inner mouth. Full coverage charcoal long tunic with side vents, brick-red shoulder cloth pinned at one collar, dark calf trousers. Holding a small woven seed basket against left hip and pinching one dried seed pod in right fingers. One soft diagonal satchel, no armor.

designs.name: Novice du repérage
designs.design: Young adult male, wiry hunched attentive stance with bent knees, unusually broad low Yautja dome and olive scales, evenly spaced stubby thick scalp tendrils with no beads. Four external fleshy mandibles clearly readable. Plain black wrap-front short jacket, crimson tied strip on one upper arm, broad charcoal waist wrap over simple trousers. Holds a folded unlettered hide map between hands at waist, small charcoal marking stick behind sash. No advanced scanner, no armor.

designs.name: Novice des bandages
designs.design: Young adult female, average height and broad hips under modest loose clothing, pale stone-grey scales and high domed forehead, thick tendrils of unequal lengths framing fully alien four-mandibled face. Long dark grey cuffed sleeves under charcoal tabard, muted red cloth belt and red-edged brown soft shoulder pouch. Carries two clean rolled bandages cradled in left forearm and a small closed wooden salve box in right palm. Calm grounded wide stance; apprentice simple supplies, no healer advanced kit.

designs.name: Novice de la cour
designs.design: Young adult male, short muscular stocky torso, warm brown patterned alien skull with heavier upper orbital crown, very short thick tendrils clustered back. Visible four facial mandibles. Short charcoal vest with broad lacing over brown cloth undershirt, red waist sash with two uneven tails, black baggy knee trousers, simple wraps exposing clawed toes. One hand resting on a small empty wooden bucket handle held beside thigh, other hand bracing sash. No mask, no armor.

designs.name: Novice du messager
designs.design: Young adult female, extremely slender long-legged build but natural healthy adult proportions, large round amber-grey Yautja head, short asymmetrical thick tendrils, broad orbital ridges and explicit four external mandibles. designs.name: Novice des pièces

Holds a shallow wooden tray with a few simple carved bone fasteners, both hands below chest. Soft tool pouch on right hip, simple cloth forearm wraps, no armor.

designs.name: Novice du récit

designs.name: Novice des nœuds
